name: Mary Wagner (Marsh, Simons)
milestones: Buried at Billingstown Cemetery, Northwest Township, Williams County, Ohio
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 159793415 (via Ancestry.com, U.S., Find a Grave Index)
Ancestry.com, 1850 United States Federal Census (Coventry, Summit County, Ohio; NARA M432, roll 732, page 87b)
Ancestry.com, 1860 United States Federal Census (Richland, DeKalb County, Indiana; NARA M653, roll 254, page 242)
Ancestry.com, 1870 United States Federal Census (Northwest, Williams County, Ohio; NARA M593, roll 1282, page 145A)
Ancestry.com, Summit County, Ohio, U.S., Marriage Records, 1840–1980 (Vol. A–C), and Ohio, U.S., County Marriage Records
Ancestry.com, public member tree "A miscellaneous research tree" (tree 62391298)
notes: Born in Ohio about 1817–18 (aged 32 in 1850, 43 in 1860, 53 in 1870); the Ancestry trees give 30 Jan 1818, and her death as 25 Dec 1889 in Williams County, Ohio.

She married Henry Symons as "Mary Marsh" on 24 Apr 1845 in Summit County, Ohio. Find a Grave and the family trees give her birth surname as Wagner or Wagoner, so she was probably a widow, Mrs. Marsh, when she married Henry; no record found so far shows the Wagner name or a first husband.

Mary Jane Simons Fryman's 1919 death certificate names her mother as Elizabeth Marsh, born in Ohio. With the 1845 marriage record's "Mary Marsh", this suggests Marsh may have been her birth surname rather than a first husband's, or that Henry had an earlier wife; the Wagner name appears only on Find a Grave and in trees.
